I guess this cat is living in the Silla's royal mausoleum because of a tag on the neck. Amazingly I met this cat first time but he? she? was so friendly to us. The mausoleum's historical implication and the cat's cuteness were both generous reward to me instead of deadly cold I felt. It was happy weekend.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Azimanak Hunt Lv.11 Autoplaying with Tamarinne
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/bVYf9Fa

Finally I got Tamarinne from mystic summon... It's long time, really. I recorded this dungeon playing with three members but actually I don't need to play this anymore because I have made *6stars over 50 already... maybe for me best members for Azaminak is Tamarinne, Bellona, Iseria and Vildred.

Finally there'll be new contents to play soon next week, the Tower has 100 floors which is playable again every months. I'm looking forward to play the Tower, although PvP is all spams of Sage Baals.

- Team profile : https://imgur.com/a/YVoOQjB

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Executioner Karkanis Hell difficulty with Dizzy
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/7nxewqH

- About Dizzy
Because her 3skill always misses, first time I thought she isn't fit versus Karkanis because of counter. But Dizzy's debuffs and CR pushing are so crazy. With Dizzy, Boss's attack isn't that hurt anymore.   Although boss resisted Luna's armorebreak two times, killing the boss wasn't hard work. 
Dizzy is one of good pick in Arena also, I strongly recommend to pull her up. Even she is cute.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Banshee Lv.11 Autoplaying with Baiken
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/8RJY11o

- About Baiken
Although I could not build Baiken's equipments fully, it's enough to kill Banshee Queen at once. This tactic's problem is, if the Queen resists armorbreak (there's always 15% chance to resist although your effectiveness is high enough because of this game's system) Baiken cannot kill the Queen at once. But anyway it's extremely fast run. Maybe some of guys already use this kind of team I think.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Indomitable Knight Epic Hell
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/MKgu0b7

- About Indomitable Knight Epic Hell
Cermia is Fire element, but Charles is Earth element... so it's hard to pick Water element DPS so I could not pick Chloe... it's sad.
Anyway, Healer and Dispelling Hero is necessary. This time also Iseria or F.Kluri is great, but Iseria is hard to deal with Cermia so I felt Cermia is harder to beat than Charles. F.Kluri's dispelling does not matter element so it's good but Elson''s CR will be boosted.
Personally I felt this isn't harder like Xeno Epic Hell. Good luck.
If you trained Carmainerose pick her as DPS and dispelling both. She will be great pick in this map I think.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Azimanak Lv.11 Autoplaying
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/5d1ZqYb

- About Azimanak hunt
Because of Azimanak's Explosive Force passive, Cannot Buff is necessary for stop increasing boss's status. Iseria, Basar or others who has Cannot Buff is necessary maybe. Or Dispelling is possible to deal with boss like F.Kluri, Tamarinne or others. I selected Iseria and F.Kluri both because sometimes boss could resist.
About DPS, before we kill all the eggs boss takes only 20% damage from 'not AOE skill'. So for autoplaying, AOE DPS is necessary like Vildred, Ml.Mercedes. I selected Vildred, he would be best DPS versus Azimanak I think.
Angelica is always best healer. When boss's HP is under 30% our healing skill effect is decreased by 90% but Angelica's shield is OK. Diene won't be good pick I think because boss attacks additionally when our buff is over three. Tamarinne is good offensive healer but when our HP is under 30% it would be dangerous.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Executioner Karkanis Hell difficulty (with Schuri & C.Dominiel)
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/SUBj7vQ

Schuri's CR boosting is so attractive. Even I did not invest any moragora for him but he can do his business seems like. Maybe this team would be my general pick when I kill Karkanis every week.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Abyss 90th floor
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/IgMGEg9

- About 90th floor
1. Round 2 Phase 1
When Boss's HP is under 50% she use Nightmare. So control your team HP before she goes to next phase.

2. Round 2 Phase 2
One of them is core - The one who says "Reveal the truth..." is core. "Be destroy..." is dummy. When you kill the core you can go to Phase 3. But problem is Aither's healing. Good luck.
Same as Phase 1, when you kill the core Boss uses Nightmare. So control your team HP.
When their turn your soul will be removed one by one. So before their turns are started, use all the souls.

3. Round 2 Phase 3
Boss's CR will be boosted 50% when you make debuff. So we cannot use any kind of debuff. At same time, if you could not remove your debuffs Boss's HP will be increased. So rapid debuff removing is necessary.
When Boss uses 3rd skill, your soul will be removed all. So before she uses 3rd skill, use all the souls. Usually Angelica's 3rd skill Soul burn is good choice.

4. About character pick
Basically Angelica + another healer for debuff removing is necessary because of Phase 3. Tamarinne, Diene are possible to pick. Or if you trained Jecht it's good choice.
Or if you have C.Armin, main healer + C.Armin is possible to pick.
At least one DPS is necessary because of Phase 2. Lorina, Luna, Lidica or others are possible. If you have Tamarinne, huddle of spec will be decreased a little.
I selected F.Kluri as last member, her 3rd skill is good versus Phase 1 and 2 both. Sadly 3rd skill is banned when Phase 3, be careful to stop using 3rd skill when Phase 3. (I mistook once.) Other supporters are possible to pick for better DPS or enduring damage but anyway I selected F.Kluri. Sadly Shuri, Chloe, Bellona or Iseria I could not pick because of Phase 3 - any kind of characters who has debuff effects on 1st skill cannot be picked. I thought Bellona with only 15% Effectiveness is possible to pick but RNG always ruins the all battles easily.
Daydream Joker would be great pick for DPS. For healer, Potion is necessary for removing debuffs. Good luck.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Abyss 89th floor
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/TrjhCFt

- About 89th floor
I did some stupid strategy - this was first try - but important points are those - Kill the Aramintha, and don't ignore flame crystal.
Because boss copy your Spd, Defence and Immune buff, Angelica's 3rd skill isn't that good maybe. Diene, Tamarinne or Mascot Hazel would be better. C.Dominiel isn't good pick also because when you use skill which isn't attacking, Boss's CR increases 50%. But anyway, seems like Smilegate tried to make unique mechanic but it's failed. If they increases Crystal's HP this would be terrible floor, I wish they don't do that though.

Personally I felt this isn't harder like Xeno Epic Hell. Good luck.
If you trained Carmainerose pick her as DPS and dispelling both. She will be great pick in this map I think.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Azimanak Lv.11 Autoplaying
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/5d1ZqYb

- About Azimanak hunt
Because of Azimanak's Explosive Force passive, Cannot Buff is necessary for stop increasing boss's status. Iseria, Basar or others who has Cannot Buff is necessary maybe. Or Dispelling is possible to deal with boss like F.Kluri, Tamarinne or others. I selected Iseria and F.Kluri both because sometimes boss could resist.
About DPS, before we kill all the eggs boss takes only 20% damage from 'not AOE skill'. So for autoplaying, AOE DPS is necessary like Vildred, Ml.Mercedes. I selected Vildred, he would be best DPS versus Azimanak I think.
Angelica is always best healer. When boss's HP is under 30% our healing skill effect is decreased by 90% but Angelica's shield is OK. Diene won't be good pick I think because boss attacks additionally when our buff is over three. Tamarinne is good offensive healer but when our HP is under 30% it would be dangerous.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Abyss 90th floor
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/IgMGEg9

- About 90th floor
1. Round 2 Phase 1
When Boss's HP is under 50% she use Nightmare. So control your team HP before she goes to next phase.

2. Round 2 Phase 2
One of them is core - The one who says "Reveal the truth..." is core. "Be destroy..." is dummy. When you kill the core you can go to Phase 3. But problem is Aither's healing. Good luck.
Same as Phase 1, when you kill the core Boss uses Nightmare. So control your team HP.
When their turn your soul will be removed one by one. So before their turns are started, use all the souls.

3. Round 2 Phase 3
Boss's CR will be boosted 50% when you make debuff. So we cannot use any kind of debuff. At same time, if you could not remove your debuffs Boss's HP will be increased. So rapid debuff removing is necessary.
When Boss uses 3rd skill, your soul will be removed all. So before she uses 3rd skill, use all the souls. Usually Angelica's 3rd skill Soul burn is good choice.

4. About character pick
Basically Angelica + another healer for debuff removing is necessary because of Phase 3. Tamarinne, Diene are possible to pick. Or if you trained Jecht it's good choice.
Or if you have C.Armin, main healer + C.Armin is possible to pick.
At least one DPS is necessary because of Phase 2. Lorina, Luna, Lidica or others are possible. If you have Tamarinne, huddle of spec will be decreased a little.
I selected F.Kluri as last member, her 3rd skill is good versus Phase 1 and 2 both. Sadly 3rd skill is banned when Phase 3, be careful to stop using 3rd skill when Phase 3. (I mistook once.) Other supporters are possible to pick for better DPS or enduring damage but anyway I selected F.Kluri. Sadly Shuri, Chloe, Bellona or Iseria I could not pick because of Phase 3 - any kind of characters who has debuff effects on 1st skill cannot be picked. I thought Bellona with only 15% Effectiveness is possible to pick but RNG always ruins the all battles easily.
Daydream Joker would be great pick for DPS. For healer, Potion is necessary for removing debuffs. Good luck.

3. Round 2 Phase 3
Boss's CR will be boosted 50% when you make debuff. So we cannot use any kind of debuff. At same time, if you could not remove your debuffs Boss's HP will be increased. So rapid debuff removing is necessary.
When Boss uses 3rd skill, your soul will be removed all. So before she uses 3rd skill, use all the souls. Usually Angelica's 3rd skill Soul burn is good choice.

4. About character pick
Basically Angelica + another healer for debuff removing is necessary because of Phase 3. Tamarinne, Diene are possible to pick. Or if you trained Jecht it's good choice.
Or if you have C.Armin, main healer + C.Armin is possible to pick.
At least one DPS is necessary because of Phase 2. Lorina, Luna, Lidica or others are possible. If you have Tamarinne, huddle of spec will be decreased a little.
I selected F.Kluri as last member, her 3rd skill is good versus Phase 1 and 2 both. Sadly 3rd skill is banned when Phase 3, be careful to stop using 3rd skill when Phase 3. (I mistook once.) Other supporters are possible to pick for better DPS or enduring damage but anyway I selected F.Kluri. Sadly Shuri, Chloe, Bellona or Iseria I could not pick because of Phase 3 - any kind of characters who has debuff effects on 1st skill cannot be picked. I thought Bellona with only 15% Effectiveness is possible to pick but RNG always ruins the all battles easily.
Daydream Joker would be great pick for DPS. For healer, Potion is necessary for removing debuffs. Good luck.

snippet.title: Epic Seven - Abyss 89th floor
snippet.description:
- Team Profile : https://imgur.com/a/TrjhCFt

- About 89th floor
I did some stupid strategy - this was first try - but important points are those - Kill the Aramintha, and don't ignore flame crystal.
Because boss copy your Spd, Defence and Immune buff, Angelica's 3rd skill isn't that good maybe. Diene, Tamarinne or Mascot Hazel would be better. C.Dominiel isn't good pick also because when you use skill which isn't attacking, Boss's CR increases 50%. But anyway, seems like Smilegate tried to make unique mechanic but it's failed. If they increases Crystal's HP this would be terrible floor, I wish they don't do that though.
